headline.note: Full-time cleaning is explicitly supported, but its employer and dates are missing. Other early work is undated; union, party, governance, study and Senate roles are kept separate. research_notes: Identify early cleaning, hospitality and waste employers, dates, hours, control and any breaks; retain explicitly supported full-time cleaning without inventing a duration. Seek dated TWU organiser appointments, pre-TWU union work, TWUSUPER reports, governance tenure and study overlaps.

2026-09-29 initial avenues: official indexed biography and frozen occupations, personal and ALP biographies, union 2018/2019 transition releases, TWUSUPER annual-report search and contemporary trustee conference reporting. Direct APH open returned 403; no bypass attempted. Targeted early-employer/first-speech searches were noisy and did not establish dates.

Resolve title discrepancy: APH gives national secretary 2006–2019; contemporaneous TWU releases establish August 2018 succession and later coordinator work. Do not merge these as uninterrupted national-secretary tenure. Source links retain both accounts.

First-speech transcript, historical union appointment returns and TWUSUPER annual reports remain follow-up leads. All union/party/governance overlaps are excluded rather than double-counted. This partial record is not research-complete.

2026-10-01 follow-up: first speech recovered. Added six-week unpaid Ferris wheel work, 1989 Liquor Trades Union disputes-officer evidence and Workers Compensation Advisory Council membership at 30 June 2000. TWU work anchored by 1994 recollection; prior organiser cessation assumption removed.

Searched early employer names, first speech, historical union roles, TWUSUPER annual reports and WorkCover records. First speech does not name cleaning, bar or waste employers. Brewery/nightclub/Cedar Lake references describe union campaigns and do not establish employment by those businesses. No date subtraction from age or 42-year workforce claim.

NSW secretary election year differs: TWU timeline 1998 versus APH service from 1999. Seek contemporary election return and payroll transition. TWUSUPER appointment and resignation, Harvard/UNSW study dates, ACTU vice-presidency and earlier job hours remain unresolved. First-person party membership age conflicts with official year; neither counted.

Access: Queensland archival PDF direct fetch and Parlinfo source returned Internal Error; indexed newspaper occupation and accessible Hansard reproductions explicitly identified. WorkCover annual report read directly. No private personnel records sought or outreach sent.

Second follow-up2October2026: targeted early cleaner/hospitality employer, Harvard timing and TWUSUPER appointment/cessation searches did not resolve personal dates or contracts. Current member/Humanitix biographies repeat full-time cleaning without employer or duration. Capital and Main22August2016 interview https://capitalandmain.com/trucks-buses-and-trade-talking-with-australian-labor-leader-tony-sheldon-0822 concerns union campaigns; full-time references describe Toll drivers, not Sheldon. VTA Autumn2022 Priority Report p14 https://www.vta.com.au/s/77-Priority-Report-Autumn.pdf includes his recollection of meeting Paul Ryan nearly34years earlier and then becoming a TWU official; rounded recollection is not an appointment date and must be reconciled with the1989 Liquor Trades role. Mayne Nickless was a campaign counterpart, not established personal employer. Paul Fletcher2013 Hansard retrospectively places him on TWUSUPER around2012 but does not resolve endpoints. Same-name actor, medical journalist and development researcher results excluded. Seek contemporary union election/payroll returns, trustee appointment register and university completion records. No materially new employment fact or full-time duration established in this pass.

Third follow-up3October2026: repeated exact-name searches for the cleaning, bartending and waste employers, TWUSUPER appointment records and Harvard program timing returned only already recorded biographies and a2013 Hansard reference placing him on the super-fund board around2012. That approximate point-in-time was already retained as a lead and does not establish tenure. A Sydney Morning Herald archive URL for his2018 union departure was non-retrievable and public summaries added no employer, contract, hours or leave evidence. Existing facts and null totals remain unchanged.

Fourth follow-up4October2026 narrowed queries to TWUSUPER appointment wording, the1998 NSW-secretary election, the1989 Liquor Trades role and early employer descriptions. Results were dominated by the same-name actor and US academic and returned no contemporary union return, trustee instrument, employer identity, contract, hours or leave. A secondary summary describing acting federal secretary in2006 does not improve the official2006 national-secretary chronology and was not added. The unresolved items now require union election/payroll archives, trustee registers or named early-employer records rather than another general exact-name search.
